title: Mean of an Exponential Distribution via Integration by Parts
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Verify that the mean of the exponential distribution f(t) = c e^(-ct) on [0, oo) is 1/c.

steps.title: Apply Integration by Parts
steps.mathExpression: u = t \implies du = dt; \quad dv = c e^{-ct} dt \implies v = -e^{-ct}
steps.why: Integration by parts on t e^(-ct).

steps.title: Evaluate Boundary Terms and Remaining Integral
steps.explanation: Boundary terms vanish; remaining integral yields 1/c.
